AllowWritesWithoutIPCPassword.title: Allow saving without IPCPassword
AllowWritesWithoutIPCPassword.description: Off by default: saving needs IPCPassword in ASF.json. Turn it on only when ASF's IPC is reachable from a trusted network alone (LAN or VPN), because then anyone who can reach it can change your plugins' settings. Secrets of plugins with a schema stay hidden either way, but the raw JSON editor shows values as stored, so it stays off until IPCPassword is set.
